capabilities: Open .dxf files in a dedicated view
Render DXF embeds in reading mode with ![[file.dxf]]
Measure distances between vertices and curves
Measure circle and arc diameters with unit auto-detection or manual override
extras: Desktop-only for the initial release; embed rendering is intended for reading mode only; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or display DXF CAD files, so users must leave the app to view drawings stored in their vault.
summary: CAD drawing viewer that opens DXF files in a dedicated view, renders them as note embeds, and measures distances, diameters, and X/Y components.
